approach.description: Implementation approach recommendation. Use 'scaffold-lead' when lead-dev should scaffold interfaces AND implement the complex/high-risk parts before junior fills remaining stubs.

reasoning.description: Detailed explanation of the approach decision.

requires_product_review.description: True if a product decision was made that should be reviewed in a follow-up issue.

review_issue_title.description: Title for the product review follow-up issue, if requires_product_review is true.

review_issue_body.description: Body for the product review follow-up issue, if requires_product_review is true.
